limits: Synthetic development fixtures, not a held-out Saudi speaker, WER or reliability benchmark.
First audible audio can include an acknowledgment; it does not prove completion of a useful semantic answer. Received-speech review checks six specific turns separately.
Readbacks use downloaded/decoded speech and elapsed simulated playback receipts, not browser microphone/autoplay certification.

Intermittent v18 silent/stalled calls passed isolated reproductions; v20 passed all three interruption offsets plus checkout and private storage, but failed initial call start and the pizza cancellation repeat; the complete current run is reported separately, not a reliability certification. Earlier failures remain visible. A successful rerun does not erase them. Historical human archives remain on the PC.

funded_failed_attempts.failure: Test incorrectly rejected the authorized checkout introduction; checker corrected to distinguish exact readback from ordinary replies. Real speculative filler also observed.
Pizza cancellation was lost between disagreeing transcripts; recovery now preserves critical meaning from both and clarifies unresolved conflict.
Mixed service change and explicit readback returned a sales question; added exact-readback completion guard after successful edits.
City omitted when an imperative address question lacked punctuation; now closed-set current city/zone answers persist directly and address guard is punctuation-independent.
Overbroad failed-edit guard blocked fresh readback after rejected premature confirmation; guard narrowed to edits, retaining unchanged-order and unheard-confirmation protection.

Synthesized checkout omitted the final confirmation question; independent full/tail transcription confirmed it. v17 streams the body plus a separately verified reusable question through a single MP3 encoder.
TTS pronounced 18 unclearly; both recognizers heard an incorrect amount. v18 spells monetary values in Arabic while keeping numeric order state unchanged.

Partial-turn recognition published a stale clarification; v19 checks freshness before auditing that failure. A silent staff reply and a startup timeout passed individual reproductions; v19 also waits for microphone/provider readiness, without claiming the intermittent failures are fully explained.
Unnecessary checking prelude leaked after pickup; v20 waits for correlated context-injection acknowledgment before unmuting and reinforces direct question wording.

One Vercel start returned 500 with a closed-connection log; v21 validates pooled connections before use. Five of six journeys passed; pizza cancellation needed a second clarification because mixed-script Cancel طلبي was rejected; added equivalent complete-utterance spelling without relaxing negation/conditional guards.

Unsupported bread correction took 10.25 seconds to first audio through two planner passes. Audit also found delivery silently selected on the preceding dish-only request; the old state assertion omitted service. V23 rejects ungrounded fulfillment, adds a bounded direct bread correction, and asserts service remains unset.

Three journeys failed: both recognizers agreed on a malformed cancellation phrase; a staff-decline reply was observed outgoing but not received above the caller threshold; fused برمو skipped the direct bread correction. V24 asks for a repeat on the malformed request, requires sustained outgoing signal before suppressing speech recovery, and accepts the narrowly bounded fused bread form. Missing-reply root cause is not conclusively isolated.

All 28 journey state assertions passed, plus received-speech, interruptions, checkout and storage. The audio-check question took 9.69 seconds to first received audio; its verification stage took 7048 ms. V25 bypasses secondary verification only for a bounded can-you-hear-me phrase, which cannot change an order or end/wait a call.

funded_failed_attempts.stage: three repeated controls and staff journeys
funded_failed_attempts.failure: All 30 state checks passed and audio checks improved to 1.51/1.66/1.56 seconds, but one goodbye took 9.91 seconds to first audio and hit its eight-second playback timeout. V26 removes the network synthesis dependency for five verified fixed phrases and logs synthesis/interrupt/playback phases; exact prior stall phase was not captured.

funded_failed_attempts.stage: three repeated controls and staff journeys
funded_failed_attempts.failure: One pause failed when recognition split انتظر شوي لو سمحت: the verified polite suffix لو سمحت was treated as a fresh restaurant request. V27 holds exact polite suffixes silent only while already waiting, preserves mixed/new requests, and prevents duplicate consumed captions reopening output. Five other repeated journeys passed; the failed run remains failed.

All 28 journey turns, three interruption offsets, 11 checkout and seven storage checks passed. In the separate speech review, readback began then provider generation failed; incomplete playback correctly could not confirm. The old UI mislabeled this as an order change and hid retry. V28 offers replay for incomplete audio, bounds speech idle time and client stalls, and logs the precise failure phase. An earlier V27 rollout attempt reached V26 workers and was rejected as mismatched evidence.

Received-speech and checkout hit upstream speech streaming failures; one other reply fallback stalled. The same failure reproduced outside Vercel. One English drink turn omitted explicitly stated half sugar; one staff offer was spoken without a pending offer. V30 adds a bounded pre-audio retry, shorter measured speech instructions, complete single-beverage option supplementation and reversed offer wording guard. All prior failures remain visible.

Three of four scenarios passed. Medium sugar repeated the whole sugar menu instead of storing a single proposal, making the next yes ambiguous. V30 binds a half-sugar clarification to the current line and revision while preserving other edits; its answer cannot authorize checkout. No full V29 cloud suite was run.

Original six-turn received-speech assertions passed, but reviewing actual speech exposed a wrong bread question after saj was saved. First three journey states passed, with a 13.81-second state outlier. Live credit then exhausted; later journeys and interruption starts timed out. Runner was stopped and checkout/storage were not completed. V31 candidate fixes speech provenance and billing aborts; live retest pending.
